primaryAbilities.name: Silver Bolts
primaryAbilities.description: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: <spellPassive>Passive</spellPassive>: Every third consecutive Attack or Ability against an enemy deals an additional <trueDamage>{{ totaldamage }} max Health true damage</trueDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
